page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9h.xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores of an x86_64 Hygon 7447v processor running at a clock speed of 2.6 GHz. The instance is configured with 1.0 thread per core, ensuring dedicated execution resources without hyperthreading overhead.

The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.c9h.xlarge offers a balanced compute-focused profile for workloads requiring consistent CPU performance without the overhead of shared-core architectures. It is suitable for compute-intensive tasks, web serving, and lightweight application hosting that do not require high memory capacity or local storage.
